result.title: MemTrial: Learning When to Trust Memory in LLM Portfolio Agents
result.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents for portfolio management learn from experience: they credit each experience in their memory with the outcome of the decisions that used it. In financial markets, however, this outcome mostly reflects the market move shared by all decisions on that date, so the credit tracks the market rather than the experience, and these agents often do worse than simply holding the equal-weight (1/$N$) portfolio. We ask how an agent can credit an experience with what it changes, and answer it by putting memory on trial: drafts of the same decision with and without an experience face the same market, so the outcome they share cancels in their difference. Our agent, MemTrial, drafts each decision with eight combinations of its retrieved experiences, chosen by a fractional factorial design, and credits each experience with its Banzhaf value, the average of these differences. As each date occurs once and each draft is a noisy LLM sample, these credits are noisy and may not hold on new dates. MemTrial therefore pools them across dates and similar experiences with a hierarchical Bayesian model, acts on them only after they have predicted unseen dates, and otherwise stays anchored at a conservative reference such as 1/$N$. On four benchmarks, MemTrial not only benefits from experiences that matter (the best of 15 methods on a semi-synthetic benchmark with known experience quality) but also limits its losses when its values do not hold (at most 2.2\% below 1/$N$ on PortBench and InvestorBench, against 15--38\% for the best experience-learning agent). Averaged over five settings, it improves the utility of the best experience-learning agent by 21.2\%, and with eight LLMs it beats every LLM-based baseline on InvestorBench.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 LLM 组合管理智能体中记忆条目的信用分配问题：提出 MemTrial，用分数因子设计生成同一决策的多种草稿（含/不含某条经验），以这些差分的 Banzhaf 值为经验定信用，再经分层贝叶斯跨日期汇总，仅在信用能预测未见过日期时才采用，否则回退到 1/N 等保守参照。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「同一决策带与不带某条经验、以差分校准组件贡献」的反事实消融思路，可能可供核查于度量 LVR 中某段 latent 或视觉证据对答案的因果贡献与是否真被使用；仅在能预测新样本时启用、否则回退的信任门控，或可类比 STOP 与视觉证据筛选的成本收益判断，但领域为金融、需较多迁移核查。
